title: Carrying Different Types of Load
whatItIs: Some loads have their own rules: pallets, curtainsiders, tippers, plant, IBCs, gas cylinders and more. The common thread: make the load stable first, then secure it to the vehicle.

keyFacts.text: Pallets: the load MUST be secured to the pallet as one unit before loading. Securing the pallet alone isn't enough.
Standard curtainsiders: buckle straps and internal nets MUST NOT be used for items or stacks over 400 kg.

keyFacts: Secure stacked pallets by the stack's weight: two 300 kg pallets stacked count as 600 kg.

keyFacts.text: Tippers: you MUST NOT use a net if the load is above the sides, or rely on the load settling below them.

visual.caption: Quick rules for some load types

rows: Barriers front and rear plus lashings: usually at least 4 direct lashings
At least 2 loop (choke) lashings, unless clamped
2 lashing straps over the frame, or a system that spreads the force
Secure the last row with 2 frictional lashings
Single layer, stable without lashings, up to 400 kg each
Never in the cab or footwell. LPG containers upright

a.label: Standard curtainsider
points: Buckle straps or nets: up to 400 kg

b.label: XL curtainsider (BS EN 12642 XL)
points: Body restrains the load if it positively fits
Within 30 cm front and rear, 8 cm sides

onTheTest.question: You're carrying two 300 kg pallets stacked on each other. What weight should you secure them for?
options: 600 kg, the weight of the stack
onTheTest.why: Use the weight of the stack, not individual pallets: two stacked 300 kg pallets are secured as a 600 kg pallet.

onTheTest.question: Where must you never carry gas cylinders?
options: In racks fitted to the vehicle
Upright in a ventilated cargo space
onTheTest.why: Cylinders must not be carried in the cab or footwell of any vehicle: they could cause injury in a collision.

traps: A gap over 30 cm cancels the XL rating: secure the load as in a non-XL vehicle.
XL-rated curtains on a standard trailer don't make it an XL vehicle.
An unstable load can never be made safe with lashings alone.
